summary: Iteration 5 Moments testing: 24/24 new pytest tests PASS (catalog shape, POST scoping rules, intensity 1-5, trigger trimming + 20-cap, list/filter/sort, delete 404/403, insights shape + days clamp 1-180, CSV content-type + Content-Disposition + ';'-joined triggers). Regression: 36/36 prior backend (mission/streak/games-clues) PASS. AI suite intentionally skipped per instructions. Frontend: parent flow works end-to-end — /parent/moments loads, Add modal opens, type/intensity slider/triggers/text fields submit successfully, list refreshes, filter dropdowns work, delete works, /parent/moments/insights renders with chart-cooccurrence + insights-range. ONE BLOCKER: /student/checkin submit fails with 422 'Field required' because the frontend sends student_id:undefined (stripped by axios JSON) but backend Pydantic MomentCreate.student_id is a non-optional str. The student-cannot-actually-check-in via UI. Backend pytest passed only because tests always pass a (bogus) student_id string.

critical.issue: MomentCreate.student_id is typed `str` (required) with no default. When the StudentCheckIn UI omits the field, Pydantic returns 422 'Field required' BEFORE the route handler can ignore it. The spec says student_id should be IGNORED for student role — but Pydantic validation rejects the request first. Fix: declare `student_id: Optional[str] = None` on MomentCreate (the route's _student_id_for() already handles both None and supplied values for students; the parent 400 path still works because supplied=None triggers the 'student_id is required for parent' branch).

minor.issue: duration_minutes has no Pydantic Field bounds — a negative or absurd value is stored as-is. Suggest Field(ge=0, le=1440).
moment_type accepts arbitrary free-text including empty string (after .strip()). Consider min_length=1 or a guard so '' is rejected.

Uses str() coercion on commas/newlines/quotes — Python's csv.writer handles quoting correctly, but values that contain ';' will be ambiguous with the triggers separator. Low impact (triggers are catalog keys today).

ui_bugs.issue: Submit always shows 'Field required' error. Root cause is the backend Pydantic schema (see CRITICAL above), but the frontend can also be hardened: send `student_id: ''` instead of `undefined` so axios serializes the key.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end /student/checkin → POST /api/moments returns 422; checkin-done screen never appears. Blocks the kid-facing Moments entry point entirely.

issues: Student chip row is hidden when students.length === 1 — that is fine functionally, but consider always showing the single linked student name as a heading so the parent visually confirms which child they are logging for. As-is, the Add button just becomes enabled silently.

rca of the issue:
RCA — Student check-in 422 'Field required':
  Reproduction: Login as student@demo.com → click 'How am I feeling?' → choose any moment type → click 'Save check-in'. Observed: red 'Field required' error inside [data-testid="checkin-error"]; checkin-done never reached; network tab shows POST /api/moments → 422 {detail:[{loc:['body','student_id'],msg:'Field required'}]}.
  Cause: StudentCheckIn.jsx submit() sends `{ student_id: undefined, moment_type, intensity, triggers, notes }`. Axios serializes JSON and drops undefined keys, so the request body has NO student_id field. Backend MomentCreate declares `student_id: str` (no Optional, no default), so Pydantic rejects the request BEFORE the route handler can apply _student_id_for() (which would correctly resolve to user.id for the student role).
  Why the pytest suite didn't catch it: my backend test test_student_self_log_ignores_supplied_student_id always passes a bogus string for student_id to verify the IGNORED-for-student behavior; it never tests the omitted-key path that the real UI uses.
  Fix (one-line, backend, recommended):
    /app/backend/server.py line 872, change
      `student_id: str`
    to
      `student_id: Optional[str] = None`
    No other change needed — _student_id_for() already handles both None and supplied values: for a student it returns user['id'] regardless, and for a parent it raises 400 when supplied is falsy (which `None` is).
  Fix (frontend, also recommended for defense-in-depth):
    /app/frontend/src/pages/StudentCheckIn.jsx line ~37 — send `student_id: ''` instead of `undefined`, so axios always includes the key.
  Validation after fix: re-run /student/checkin manually; also add a pytest case that POSTs WITHOUT the student_id key and asserts 200 with logged_by_role='student'.
